Be part of the team rewriting the rules of construction.

Construction is at an inflection point. Trillions of dollars are at stake, complexity is surging, and the old way of running projects no longer works. Buildots is building the AI layer the industry will run on. We’re scaling fast, partnering with the largest players on the planet, and redefining how capital gets deployed. Ready to join us?

Who we are.

We're building a culture where every employee is empowered to innovate, solve problems, and push boundaries.

Driven by passion

No matter their area of expertise, our people are passionate about what they do.

Motivated by excellence

We hire smart, ambitious people who work hard, learn fast, and aim high.

Trusted through transparency

We give our people responsibility and autonomy. Take the initiative and talk to whoever you need to get the job done.

Proven with innovation

We combine elite AI, computer vision and construction expertise. This unique blend helps us innovate faster and better than others.
